name: Village pork skewers
summary: Thịt lợn bản xiên is one of the town grills the national desk names for a cold night. A recipe and a price were not printed.
origin: Named with the other town grills: salmon, chicken wings, beef and enoki, eggs, chestnuts, and cơm lam.
howToEat: Eat it at the stalls. The page gives no further method. Check on arrival.
where: Stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, in cold night air. The hour is check on arrival.
seoTitle: Village pork skewers in Sapa — a cold-night grill
